title: set-domains output
description: How each domain's routes came out. route_failures are real Traefik-side failures; waiting_for_dns are domains whose route creation was deliberately skipped because their DNS isn't ready yet (DESIGN.md 5.6) -- reconcile() (via check-dns) will create their routes once it is, no further action needed. Both empty means everything applied cleanly. Call get-domains for full per-record DNS status.
